freeze_policy: All previous displayed samples use the same operations chain; fixed M10 tasks, original floor demand and clearance rules. Door correction is input migration, never algorithm gain.

scenarios.title: 无障碍矩形

scenarios.input_change_note: M11 明确实体外围墙及门洞，入口改为门外 600 mm；店内拣货/收货/打包位置、固定任务、需求下限和规则保留。
